title: Linear Equations
meta: Lesson practice set · Question types of the April 2026 NIOS paper
instructions: Practice set for this lesson in the question types of the April 2026 paper.
Every answer shows the working. Where a question has OR, answer either one.
Questions from previous NIOS papers show the exam they appeared in.

questions.q: Which of the following is NOT a linear equation?
questions.work:
An equation must have an '=' sign joining two expressions.
2x + 3 = 7, x − y = 4 and 3x = 9 are equations of degree one.
5x + 7 is only an expression — it is not an equation at all.

questions.q: Which of the following is NOT a linear equation?
questions.work:
A linear equation has every variable with power 1.
In x + y² = 7 − 2x the term y² has degree 2, so it is not linear.

questions.q: The solution of 2x + 3y + 5 = 0 and 3x − 2y − 12 = 0 is —
questions.work:
Multiply the first by 2 and the second by 3: 4x + 6y + 10 = 0 and 9x − 6y − 36 = 0.
Add: 13x − 26 = 0 ⇒ x = 2.
Then 2(2) + 3y + 5 = 0 ⇒ 3y = −9 ⇒ y = −3.
Check: 3(2) − 2(−3) − 12 = 6 + 6 − 12 = 0 ✓.

questions.q: The graph of y = −3 is a line —
questions.work:
On y = −3 every point has y-coordinate −3, e.g. (0, −3), (5, −3).
All the points are at the same height, so the line is parallel to the x-axis, 3 units below it.

questions.q: The line 2x + 3y = 6 meets the y-axis at —
questions.work:
On the y-axis x = 0.
2(0) + 3y = 6 ⇒ y = 2.
So the line meets the y-axis at (0, 2).

questions.q: The coefficient of y in 5(2x − 4) + 3x + 4y − 7 = 0 is —
questions.work:
Expand: 10x − 20 + 3x + 4y − 7 = 0 ⇒ 13x + 4y − 27 = 0.
The coefficient of y is 4.

questions.q: The pair kx + 2y = 5 and 3x + y = 1 has no solution when k is —
questions.work:
No solution means parallel lines: a₁/a₂ = b₁/b₂ ≠ c₁/c₂.
k/3 = 2/1 ⇒ k = 6.
Check c₁/c₂ = 5/1 = 5 ≠ 2, so the lines are parallel, not the same. k = 6.

questions.q: If the difference of two numbers is 5 and the smaller is 36, the greater is —
questions.work:
Let the greater be x and the smaller y: x − y = 5.
x − 36 = 5 ⇒ x = 41.

questions.q: The point (4, 3) on the line 3x + 7y = 27 —
options: does not lie on the line
questions.work:
Put x = 4, y = 3: 3(4) + 7(3) = 12 + 21 = 33.
33 ≠ 27, so (4, 3) does not lie on the line.

questions.q: The equations x + 2y = 4 and 2x + 4y = 8 have —
questions.work:
a₁/a₂ = 1/2, b₁/b₂ = 2/4 = 1/2, c₁/c₂ = 4/8 = 1/2.
All three ratios are equal, so the lines coincide: infinitely many solutions.

sections.title: Objective type questions: each has two parts of 1 mark (fill in the blanks, match the columns or true/false).

questions.q: Match: (i) The coefficient of y in 5(2x − 4) + 3x + 4y − 7 = 0 is ____ (ii) When y = 3 is written as ax + by + c = 0, a is ____ — (A) 0 (B) 3 (C) 4
questions.answer:
(i) Expanding: 13x + 4y − 27 = 0, so the coefficient of y is 4 → (C).
(ii) y = 3 is 0·x + 1·y − 3 = 0, so a = 0 → (A).

questions.q: Write True or False: (i) The graph of 2x + 3y = 6 cuts the y-axis at (0, 2). (ii) The graph of x = 2 is a line parallel to the x-axis.
questions.answer:
(i) True: x = 0 gives 3y = 6, y = 2.
(ii) False: on x = 2 every point has x = 2, so it is parallel to the y-axis.

questions.q: Fill in the blanks: (i) 2x + 3y = 7 and (p − 1)x + (p + 2)y = 3p have infinitely many solutions when p = ____. (ii) kx + 2y = 5 and 3x + y = 1 have no solution when k = ____.
Write True or False: (i) The point (4, 3) lies on 3x + 7y = 27. (ii) The graph of y = −3 is parallel to the x-axis.
questions.answer:
(i) False: 3(4) + 7(3) = 33 ≠ 27.
(ii) True: every point on it has y = −3.

questions.q: 'MATHSBOLA' — Fill in the blanks: (i) 'The difference of two numbers is 5' as an equation is ____. (ii) If the smaller number is 36, the greater is ____.
questions.answer:
(i) Let the greater be x and the smaller y: x − y = 5.
(ii) x − 36 = 5 ⇒ x = 41.

sections.passage: A school canteen sells sandwiches and juice. Riya pays ₹70 for 2 sandwiches and 1 juice. Aman pays ₹60 for 1 sandwich and 2 juices. Let one sandwich cost ₹x and one juice ₹y.

questions.q: 1 table and 3 chairs cost ₹3,000; 2 tables and 1 chair cost ₹3,750. Find the cost of a table and of a chair.
questions.answer:
Let a table cost ₹t and a chair ₹c.
t + 3c = 3000 …(1); 2t + c = 3750 …(2).
From (1), t = 3000 − 3c. Put in (2): 6000 − 6c + c = 3750 ⇒ 5c = 2250 ⇒ c = 450.
t = 3000 − 1350 = 1650.
A table costs ₹1,650 and a chair ₹450.

questions.q: Solve 3x − y = 5 and 4x + 3y = 11.
questions.answer:
From the first, y = 3x − 5.
Substitute: 4x + 3(3x − 5) = 11 ⇒ 13x − 15 = 11 ⇒ x = 2.
y = 3(2) − 5 = 1.
Solution: x = 2, y = 1.

questions.q: Solve by elimination: 2x + 3y = 13 and 5x − 7y = −11.
questions.answer:
Multiply the first by 5 and the second by 2: 10x + 15y = 65 and 10x − 14y = −22.
Subtract: 29y = 87 ⇒ y = 3.
2x + 9 = 13 ⇒ x = 2.
Check: 5(2) − 7(3) = 10 − 21 = −11 ✓. Solution x = 2, y = 3.

questions.q: The perimeter of a rectangular garden is 20 m and its length is 4 m more than its breadth. Find its length, breadth and area.
questions.answer:
Let breadth = b, length = b + 4.
2(l + b) = 20 ⇒ (b + 4) + b = 10 ⇒ 2b = 6 ⇒ b = 3.
Length = 7 m, breadth = 3 m, area = 7 × 3 = 21 m².

questions.q: Solve x − 2y = 7 and 3x + y = 35.
questions.answer:
From the first, x = 7 + 2y.
3(7 + 2y) + y = 35 ⇒ 21 + 7y = 35 ⇒ y = 2.
x = 7 + 4 = 11. Solution x = 11, y = 2.

questions.q: For what value of k will 3x + y = 1 and (2k − 1)x + (k − 1)y = 2k + 1 have no solution?
questions.answer:
No solution: 3/(2k − 1) = 1/(k − 1) ≠ 1/(2k + 1).
3(k − 1) = 2k − 1 ⇒ 3k − 3 = 2k − 1 ⇒ k = 2.
Check: 1/(k − 1) = 1 and 1/(2k + 1) = 1/5; they differ, so the lines are parallel. k = 2.

questions.q: Solve graphically: x + y = 7, x − y = −1.
questions.answer:
x + y = 7: points (0, 7), (7, 0), (3, 4).
x − y = −1 (y = x + 1): points (0, 1), (−1, 0), (3, 4).
Plot both lines on the same graph; they intersect at (3, 4).
Solution: x = 3, y = 4. Check: 3 + 4 = 7 ✓ and 3 − 4 = −1 ✓.

questions.q: Solve graphically: x + y = 5, x − y = 1.
Solve graphically: x + y = 7, x − y = 1.
Solve graphically: x + y = 5, x − y = 3.
questions.note: April 2019 asked x − y = 3, x + y = 5 — the same pair.

questions.q: Solve graphically: 2x − 3y = 6, 2x + y = −10.

questions.answer:
Multiply the first by 3 and the second by 4: 9x + 12y = 51 and 16x − 12y = 24.
Add: 25x = 75 ⇒ x = 3.
3(3) + 4y = 17 ⇒ 4y = 8 ⇒ y = 2.
Solution x = 3, y = 2.

questions.q: Solve graphically: 2x + y − 6 = 0 and x − 2y = −2.
questions.answer:
2x + y = 6 (y = 6 − 2x): x = 0 → y = 6; x = 3 → y = 0; x = 2 → y = 2.
x − 2y = −2 (y = (x + 2)/2): x = 0 → y = 1; x = −2 → y = 0; x = 2 → y = 2.
Plot both lines on the same graph paper (1 cm = 1 unit). They cross at (2, 2).
Solution: x = 2, y = 2. Check: 2(2) + 2 − 6 = 0 ✓; 2 − 4 = −2 ✓.

or.q: If the length of a rectangle is reduced by 5 units and the breadth increased by 3 units, the area falls by 9 sq units. If the length is increased by 3 and the breadth by 2, the area grows by 67 sq units. Find the length and breadth.

questions.q: The sum of the digits of a two-digit number is 11. If the digits are reversed, the new number is 27 less than the original. Find the number.
questions.answer:
Let the tens digit be x and the units digit y; the number is 10x + y.
x + y = 11 …(1)
(10x + y) − (10y + x) = 27 ⇒ 9x − 9y = 27 ⇒ x − y = 3 …(2)
Add: 2x = 14 ⇒ x = 7; y = 4.
The number is 74. Check: 74 − 47 = 27 ✓.

questions.q: 2 men and 7 boys can do a piece of work in 4 days; 4 men and 4 boys can do it in 3 days. How long would one man alone, or one boy alone, take?
questions.answer:
Let a man do 1/m and a boy 1/b of the work in a day; put u = 1/m, v = 1/b.
4 days: 4(2u + 7v) = 1 ⇒ 8u + 28v = 1 …(1)
3 days: 3(4u + 4v) = 1 ⇒ 12u + 12v = 1 …(2)
From (2): u = 1/12 − v. Put in (1): 8/12 − 8v + 28v = 1 ⇒ 20v = 1/3 ⇒ v = 1/60.
u = 1/12 − 1/60 = 4/60 = 1/15.
A man alone takes 15 days and a boy alone 60 days.

questions.q: Three years ago Sunil was four times as old as his sister Shruti. Five years from now he will be twice her age. Find their present ages, and the father's present age if he was 25 when Sunil was born.
questions.answer:
Let Sunil be S and Shruti R years old now.
S − 3 = 4(R − 3) ⇒ S = 4R − 9 …(1)
S + 5 = 2(R + 5) ⇒ S = 2R + 5 …(2)
4R − 9 = 2R + 5 ⇒ 2R = 14 ⇒ R = 7; S = 19.
Father = 19 + 25 = 44 years.
Sunil 19, Shruti 7, father 44.
